title: Real Numbers
preview: Rational vs irrational numbers, square and cube roots, and locating irrationals between integers on the number line.
description: Students distinguish rational from irrational numbers, work with square and cube roots in real contexts, and estimate irrational values to make practical decisions.

sections.label: 2-1 Rational vs Irrational Numbers
sections.description: Classify numbers by decimal expansion: terminating, repeating, or neither.

sections.label: 2-2 Square Roots
sections.description: Find side lengths of squares and distinguish perfect from non-perfect squares.

sections.label: 2-3 Cube Roots
sections.description: Find side lengths of cubes from volume; recognise when answers are irrational.

sections.label: 2-4 Estimating Irrational Numbers
sections.description: Locate square and cube roots between two consecutive integers using perfect-square benchmarks.

sections.label: 2-5 Irrational Hypotenuses (Pythagorean Preview)
sections.description: Pythagorean diagonals that don't form Pythagorean triples — practice with irrational answers.

source.name: Plug N Play
